reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(bar) written to the HTML response; encoding is applied at the sink. The user-provided 'bar' is transformed via Base64 encode/decode (which has no effect on the value) and then properly escaped with encodeForHTML before being inserted into the HTML output. Since the encoding is correctly applied to the user-controlled data in the HTML context, the vulnerability is mitigated.
